sentences.en: We have yet to discover an effective remedy for cancer.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有发现有效的癌症治疗方法。

sentences.en: Girls wearing mini-skirts, walking or sitting, are very effective eye-openers.
sentences.zh: 穿迷你裙的女孩们无论是走路还是坐着都非常引人注目。

sentences.en: The law will be effective from the 1st of April.
sentences.zh: 该法律将于4月1日起生效。
